title: Atomic Habits Lesson Nine
aria: Animated summary of the ninth lesson of Atomic Habits: how family and friends shape your habits. Nine scenes.
scenes:
<!-- 1 Title -->
      <g id="s0">
        <text class="m" x="120" y="150" font-size="28">ATOMIC HABITS · CHAPTER 9</text>
        <text class="d" x="116" y="400" font-size="84" letter-spacing="-2">How family and friends</text>
        <text class="d" x="116" y="496" font-size="84" letter-spacing="-2">shape your habits.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="600" font-size="32">Lesson nine: we copy the habits of the people around us.</text>
        <g id="crowd"></g>
        <circle id="joiner" class="gain" r="30"/>
      </g>

      <!-- 2 Polgar -->
      <g id="s1" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">Geniuses aren’t born. They’re made.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">Psychologist László Polgár’s bold idea.</text>
        <path class="s-ink" d="M260 390L800 236L1340 390" fill="none" stroke-width="8" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <rect class="s-ink" x="300" y="390" width="1000" height="400" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="7"/>
        <g id="books">
          <rect class="s-ink" x="340" y="430" width="180" height="320" fill="none" stroke-width="5"/>
          <path class="s-ink" d="M340 536h180M340 642h180" stroke-width="5"/>
          <g id="spines"></g>
          <text class="m" x="430" y="776" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">CHESS BOOKS</text>
        </g>
        <g id="pics">
          <rect class="s-ink" x="580" y="430" width="110" height="90" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="5"/><rect class="s-ink" x="730" y="430" width="110" height="90" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="5"/><rect class="s-ink" x="880" y="430" width="110" height="90" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="5"/>
          <circle class="ink" cx="635" cy="462" r="13"/><path class="ink" d="M613 506a22 22 0 0 1 44 0z"/>
          <circle class="ink" cx="785" cy="462" r="13"/><path class="ink" d="M763 506a22 22 0 0 1 44 0z"/>
          <circle class="ink" cx="935" cy="462" r="13"/><path class="ink" d="M913 506a22 22 0 0 1 44 0z"/>
          <text class="m" x="785" y="550" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">FAMOUS PLAYERS</text>
        </g>
        <g id="board"></g>
        <rect class="ink" x="600" y="756" width="330" height="14"/>
        <g id="girls"></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 3 The sisters -->
      <g id="s2" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">It worked.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">The three Polgár sisters.</text>
        <g id="c0">
          <rect class="s-line" x="120" y="230" width="414" height="560" rx="18" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="3"/>
          <text class="d" x="156" y="390" font-size="120" letter-spacing="-3">1st</text>
          <text class="d5" x="156" y="470" font-size="48">Susan</text>
          <text class="m" x="156" y="530" font-size="20">FIRST WOMAN TO EARN THE</text><text class="m" x="156" y="562" font-size="20">GRANDMASTER TITLE IN</text><text class="m" x="156" y="594" font-size="20">TOURNAMENT PLAY</text>
        </g>
        <g id="c1">
          <rect class="s-line" x="593" y="230" width="414" height="560" rx="18" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="3"/>
          <text class="d" x="629" y="390" font-size="120" letter-spacing="-3">14</text>
          <text class="d5" x="629" y="470" font-size="48">Sofia</text>
          <text class="m" x="629" y="530" font-size="20">WORLD CHAMPION</text><text class="m" x="629" y="562" font-size="20">AT FOURTEEN</text>
        </g>
        <g id="c2">
          <rect class="s-line" x="1066" y="230" width="414" height="560" rx="18" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="3"/>
          <text class="d" x="1102" y="390" font-size="120" letter-spacing="-3" style="fill:var(--gain)">15</text>
          <text class="d5" x="1102" y="470" font-size="48">Judit</text>
          <text class="m" x="1102" y="530" font-size="20">GRANDMASTER AT FIFTEEN,</text><text class="m" x="1102" y="562" font-size="20">BREAKING FISCHER’S RECORD</text>
          <g id="j27"><text class="m" x="1102" y="640" font-size="20" style="fill:var(--gain)">NO. 1 WOMAN IN THE WORLD</text><text id="yrs" class="d" x="1102" y="730" font-size="72">27 years</text></g>
        </g>
        <g id="pieces"></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 4 Three groups -->
      <g id="s3" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">In their home, chess was normal.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">That’s culture. We copy the habits of three groups.</text>
        <g id="g0"><circle class="s-line" cx="360" cy="480" r="170" fill="none" stroke-width="4"/><g id="gd0"></g><text class="d" x="360" y="730" font-size="52" text-anchor="middle">The close</text></g>
        <g id="g1"><circle class="s-line" cx="800" cy="480" r="170" fill="none" stroke-width="4"/><g id="gd1"></g><text class="d" x="800" y="730" font-size="52" text-anchor="middle">The many</text></g>
        <g id="g2"><circle class="s-line" cx="1240" cy="480" r="170" fill="none" stroke-width="4"/>
          <circle class="ink" cx="1240" cy="560" r="16"/><circle class="ink" cx="1196" cy="574" r="12"/><circle class="ink" cx="1284" cy="574" r="12"/>
          <circle class="gain" cx="1240" cy="430" r="44"/><path class="gain" d="M1204 372l12-34 24 22 24-22 12 34z"/>
          <text class="d" x="1240" y="730" font-size="52" text-anchor="middle">The powerful</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 5 The close -->
      <g id="s4" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">1. The close.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">We pick up habits from the people nearest to us.</text>
        <g id="net"></g>
        <circle class="gain" cx="560" cy="510" r="48"/><text class="m" x="560" y="518" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:var(--on-gain)">YOU</text>
        <g id="ob">
          <text class="m" x="1020" y="360" font-size="22">IF A FRIEND BECAME OBESE,</text>
          <text class="m" x="1020" y="392" font-size="22">YOUR OWN RISK ROSE BY</text>
          <text id="obv" class="d" x="1012" y="540" font-size="150" letter-spacing="-4" style="fill:var(--loss)">+57%</text>
          <text class="m" x="1020" y="600" font-size="20">12,000 PEOPLE · 30+ YEARS</text>
        </g>
      </g>

      <!-- 6 The many -->
      <g id="s5" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">2. The many.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">Solomon Asch’s line experiment, 1950s.</text>
        <rect class="s-line" x="120" y="240" width="520" height="460" rx="18" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="3"/>
        <text class="m" x="160" y="290" font-size="20">WHICH LINE MATCHES?</text>
        <path class="s-ink" d="M200 620V420" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><text class="m" x="200" y="660" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">X</text>
        <path class="s-muted" d="M290 600h320" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 6"/>
        <path class="s-ink" d="M360 620V480" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><text class="m" x="360" y="660" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
        <path id="lineB" class="s-ink" d="M460 620V350" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><text class="m" x="460" y="660" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
        <path id="lineC" class="s-ink" d="M560 620V420" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><text class="m" x="560" y="660" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
        <g id="room"></g>
        <text class="m" x="720" y="680" font-size="20">ACTORS</text><text class="m" x="1400" y="680" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:var(--gain)">REAL SUBJECT</text>
        <g id="asch"><text class="d" x="120" y="800" font-size="46">About 3 in 4 went along with the group at least once.</text></g>
        <g id="tribe"><text class="m" x="120" y="856" font-size="22">GOING AGAINST THE TRIBE MAKES CHANGE HARD</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 7 The powerful -->
      <g id="s6" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="68">3. The powerful.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">We copy people who have status and respect.</text>
        <path class="s-ink" d="M700 760V620h200V480h200V340h200v420z" fill="var(--line)" stroke-width="0"/>
        <path class="s-ink" d="M700 760V620h200V480h200V340h200" fill="none" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <g id="top"><circle class="gain" cx="1200" cy="250" r="34"/><path class="gain" d="M1150 340v-30a50 50 0 0 1 100 0v30z"/><path class="gain" d="M1200 160l9 20 22 2-17 14 5 22-19-12-19 12 5-22-17-14 22-2z"/></g>
        <g id="looks"></g>
        <g id="fans"></g>
        <g id="appr"><text class="d" x="120" y="840" font-size="50">We want the approval they seem to get.</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 8 Join -->
      <g id="s7" opacity="0">
        <text class="d" x="120" y="124" font-size="60">Join a group where your habit is normal.</text>
        <text class="b" x="120" y="176" font-size="32">Your desired behaviour should be the group’s normal behaviour.</text>
        <g id="j0">
          <rect class="s-line" x="120" y="240" width="640" height="480" rx="18" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="3"/>
          <text class="m" x="150" y="290" font-size="22">WANT TO RUN?</text>
          <g id="runners"></g>
          <path class="s-gain" d="M200 640q220-60 480 0" fill="none" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="10 10"/>
          <text class="d5" x="150" y="700" font-size="34">Spend time with runners.</text>
        </g>
        <g id="j1">
          <rect class="s-line" x="840" y="240" width="640" height="480" rx="18" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="3"/>
          <text class="m" x="870" y="290" font-size="22">WANT TO READ MORE?</text>
          <path class="ink" d="M1100 470c-30-20-80-20-110-10v120c30-10 80-10 110 10 30-20 80-20 110-10V460c-30-10-80-10-110 10z"/>
          <path d="M1100 470v120" stroke="var(--stage)" stroke-width="4"/>
          <g id="readers"></g>
          <text class="d5" x="870" y="700" font-size="34">Join a book club.</text>
        </g>
        <circle id="you0" class="s-ink" r="22" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="6"/>
        <circle id="you1" class="s-ink" r="22" fill="var(--stage)" stroke-width="6"/>
        <g id="surr"><text class="d" x="120" y="820" font-size="38">Surround yourself with people who already have the habits you want.</text></g>
      </g>

      <!-- 9 Close -->
      <g id="s8" opacity="0">
        <g id="qa"><text class="d" x="136" y="340" font-size="88" letter-spacing="-2">Who could you spend</text></g>
        <g id="qb"><text class="d" x="136" y="450" font-size="88" letter-spacing="-2">more time with, to make</text></g>
        <g id="qc"><text class="d" x="136" y="560" font-size="88" letter-spacing="-2">your next habit feel normal?</text></g>
        <text class="m" x="143" y="700" font-size="26">JOIN THE TRIBE THAT ALREADY DOES IT</text>
      </g>
NAMES: ['Family and friends','Polgár’s idea','The sisters','Three groups','The close','The many','The powerful','Join a group','The question']
